forecast.provider: JPMorgan Global Research, attributed by Reuters
forecast.provider_return_definition: Q4 2026 average USD gold price, not a terminal price or ETF expected return
forecast.uncertainty_basis: Uncalibrated one-standard-deviation research assumptions: 10% quarterly forecast error and 2% ETF/bullion basis error. Sensitivity 5%/20%. No JPM probabilities or confidence supplied.
mapping_assumptions: Equal-weight weekday valuation average approximates the provider quarterly average; holiday weekdays use the most recent prior NAV-implied bullion valuation. Provider averaging calendar is unspecified.
NAV divided by ounces per share is a bullion proxy including trust liabilities, not licensed LBMA spot. Both inputs are from the same issuer valuation date.
Condition on already observed quarter valuations. For remaining weekdays assume a linear expected bullion price path and solve its slope to match the complete quarterly average.

Convert the expected path at its mean remaining observation horizon to GLD using current ounces per share, 0.40% annual fee decay and current ETF close. NAV valuation precedes market close; the basis-error term covers, but does not eliminate, this timing/model risk.
Propagate quarterly forecast error through the slope and ETF mapping into annual-return Omega. The shorter effective horizon raises uncertainty. Stop less than 30 calendar days before quarter end.
Recorded 9 October 2026; earlier publication reconstruction is retrospective, never prospective evidence.
